linux.failureSummary: Error: Unable to find role="checkbox" and name `/确认以上暂存修改/`

failure.observedFailure: After returning to Git, the preview helper clicks the enabled inspect control, but the explicit commit-confirmation checkbox never appears. The original full Linux failure points to preview helper line47 called from case line96.

controlledReproduction.source: 256 public web/shared files copied byte-for-byte from frozen full7 source, plus four diagnostic files; all260 copied hashes verified before and after.
controlledReproduction.environment: New task-owned Linux directory, ordinary UID65534, pinned Node24.22.1, existing verified public dependency cache, real React createRoot and Api; one explicitly selected diagnostic test.
controlledReproduction.trigger: Hold the automatic Git status response after hide/show. A MutationObserver performs one real click at the first enabled DOM state; no hook mocking, sleep or retry.
controlledReproduction.trace: clicked=true. Returned automatic status/diff/refs signals are not aborted. The first-enabled-click phase issues one new workspace/git/status whose signal becomes aborted; the staged diff and final status are never issued. The confirmation checkbox does not appear.
controlledReproduction.result: One actual probe case failed with the same missing-checkbox outcome. This confirms that a fresh preview can be canceled by the current UI lifecycle; it does not assert that the original matrix scheduler was fully captured.
controlledReproduction.harnessPreparationFailure: The initial diagnostic attempt executed zero tests because Vitest5 chose an unwritable parent workspace module-cache directory. Its log/raw result is retained separately. Only a new ignored runner supplied --fsModuleCachePath inside the diagnostic directory; copied source, probe/config, timeout and assertions remained unchanged before the single effective probe.

failure.causeStatus: Fresh-preview cancellation reproduced; independent web reviewer owns the lifecycle repair and exact consumer regressions.
